scope: Exact Keeper Boundary Post V1.1 open-front shelter exterior in Sereth's Year Four writ deployment only. Does not approve the bench, people, writ, lookout signs, paths, or battlefield.
author: Torn Asunder terrain asset author

evidence.godot_context: Matched 1280×720 native hero approach from the existing low trail, open front during the actual handover/reply, tactical sector and overview in Sereth's live writ deployment. Same surroundings, cameras, collision and scene lights.
evidence.close_up: Real front underside and near handover, legal road-side three-quarter, and supplementary east/west rear views show keyed masonry, foot, joinery and exposed rafter edge. Labels hidden only in a diagnostic.
evidence.reproduction: Godot 4.7.2 GL Compatibility. Run game/battlefield/sereth_pass_writ_playtest.tscn. Follow the sheep track to the exterior Keeper handover; aim at the actual shelter and bench. In hero view use Space/Cross within the handover ring, let the Keeper physically approach, then verify Shift/Home and M are normal tactical sector and overview. Preserve existing road and withdrawal.
evidence.measurements: 518 hero / 380 tactical triangles, one surface each, two unique S3TC textures with mips (873,840 bytes). Added 470/332/332 renderer primitives, removed three draws per lens. Eight matched short hero pairs median ratio 1.031; software-only measurements are not a console or GPU frame-rate result.

shape_and_craft.finding: A real working open shelter, with oak bearing against keyed irregular split-stone and a foot block, exposed roof layering and no invented doorway. Both returns have distinct plausible ashlar bonds. Verified dressed geometry remains in the exact physical envelope.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Distinct split stone, oak, slate and footing under original scene lights, with relieved front corner and less repetitive rear facing. Stock shadow-only forms protect existing light behavior without doubling geometry on screen.

readability_in_play.finding: Open front and external handover remain obvious. No false entrance at the separately retained bench. 22 measured native perspective/orthographic transition readings select exactly one asset view through 48 m.

integration_and_cost.finding: Clean import and inverse restores original host exactly. Original four solids, roof targeting, paths and occupation use unchanged. Fits scoped audit limits: under 1 MiB compressed, at most 500/350/350 added primitives at the three views and no added draws. Actual handover and return exercised; no target hardware benchmark.

motion_and_effects.reason: Static shelter. Native gameplay approach, true Keeper movement and handover/reply, and near-to-tactical state verified separately, without treating those actors or their effects as approved.

tests: Actual hero approach, Keeper handover, withdraw, sign-negative and held/outside checks
